# World Wide Fund for Nature (WWF)

> > WWF is a leading independent conservation organisation protecting nature, wildlife, and people through global habitat conservation, climate action, and sustainable living initiatives.

WWF-UK operates across multiple countries and landscapes, focusing on endangered species protection, climate change mitigation, nature restoration, and community engagement. The site provides educational resources, conservation reports, and practical tools for individuals and organizations to take environmental action.

## Key Topics

- Wildlife protection
- Conservation
- Climate change
- Endangered species
- Nature restoration
- Rewilding
- Sustainability
- Living Planet Act
- Amazon
- Marine ecosystems
- Climate action
- Environmental education
- Community engagement
- Carbon footprint
- Ecosystem management

## Core Conservation

- [World Wide Fund for Nature | WWF](https://www.wwf.org.uk): WWF homepage: leading independent conservation organisation for nature and people
- [We're protecting our planet's iconic wildlife | WWF](https://www.wwf.org.uk/learn/wildlife): Wildlife protection guide covering endangered species like pandas, elephants, dolphins
- [Where the WWF works around the world | WWF](https://www.wwf.org.uk/where-we-work): Global conservation locations and habitats where WWF operates worldwide
- [Living Planet Act | WWF](https://www.wwf.org.uk/act/living-planet-act): Campaign for Living Planet Act legislation to protect nature at Westminster

## Climate & Sustainability

- [Climate change | WWF](https://www.wwf.org.uk/learn/climate-change): Educational guide on climate change facts, impacts, and solutions
- [Food | WWF](https://www.wwf.org.uk/food): Food sustainability and agriculture impact on biodiversity and climate
- [Ways to help our world in 2026 | WWF](https://www.wwf.org.uk/ways-to-help-our-world): Action guide for sustainable living and conservation in homes and communities
- [Download WWF's My Footprint app | WWF](https://www.wwf.org.uk/myfootprint): Mobile app for tracking carbon footprint and sustainability challenges

## Nature Restoration & Landscapes

- [Rewilding | WWF](https://www.wwf.org.uk/learn/rewilding): Guide to rewilding and nature restoration across UK landscapes
- [Wholescape: Seeing the bigger picture | WWF](https://www.wwf.org.uk/learn/wholescape): Wholescape approach to landscape conservation in England, Scotland, Wales
- [UK walking trails | WWF](https://www.wwf.org.uk/act/trails): Feel Good Forest Trails family walking routes across England forests
- [A Prescription For Nature | WWF](https://www.wwf.org.uk/prescription-for-nature): Nature activities and wellbeing guide for mental health and community engagement

## Educational Resources

- [Supporting teachers and schools | WWF](https://www.wwf.org.uk/get-involved/schools): School programmes and teacher resources for environmental education
- [Fascinating facts about animals | WWF](https://www.wwf.org.uk/learn/fascinating-facts): Educational animal facts about endangered species and wildlife conservation
- [Welcome to Go Wild | WWF](https://www.wwf.org.uk/gowild): Kids club with wildlife facts, puzzles, crafts, and educational entertainment
- [Quiz for your world | WWF](https://www.wwf.org.uk/learn/quizzes): Interactive quizzes for children about wildlife and nature knowledge

## Knowledge & Reports

- [Our reports in the knowledge hub | WWF](https://www.wwf.org.uk/our-reports): Knowledge hub with published reports including Living Planet Report 2024
- [Articles | WWF](https://www.wwf.org.uk/articles): Conservation articles and environmental news on wildlife and sustainability

## Get Involved

- [Get involved and fight for the planet | WWF](https://www.wwf.org.uk/fundraise/get-involved): Fundraising opportunities and community events for conservation support
